summary: The filing is an 8-K reporting that RMG ML Sports Holdings, a SPAC, will allow separate trading of its units into Class A ordinary shares and rights starting July 17, 2026. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC business combination, or management change is involved. The press release attached as Exhibit 99.1 merely announces a mechanical separation of unit components with no special-situation event.
